newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks marking time until new year.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks marking time until new year.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks were left hanging in dull Thursday morning trading as investors and brokers appeared more interested in the upcoming holiday season.
The Colombo Stock Exchange all share index was down one point to 581.22 at the mid-morning break with turnover hovering just above the four million rupee mark, brokers said.
"The market is just hanging. There is no particular investor interest," a broker for Bartleet Mallory said.
Trading of a parcel of 60,000 Walkers Tours at 10.50 per share made up the morning's major activity. Blue chips Aitken Spence and Hayleys were up 4.75 and 2 rupees respectively.
"The holiday mood is reflected in the morning's activity," said Sanjeeva Gunewardena of Commercial Stockbrokers.
Other brokers said many people would lay low for the year to pass and begin aggressively in the new year.
"All indications are that the market is due a good upturn next year," said Namal Kamalgoda of CTC Eagle Fund Management.
